_comment: Expected output of build/build.js. check.js compares against this when no reference path is given. Update it in the same commit as any intentional change to src/shell.html, a module in api/, or a Config Doc in config/ — the new values are printed by `node build/check.js` when it fails.
builtFrom: src/shell.html + api/_*.js + config/*.csv — Release 4 phase 2, plus the format→type carry in ConfigApply
note: Fourth repin of this release: f243482d → cd74b2cd → df5848f0 → 5f8c6c32f7eaf6f6fc636b27779bc6458f3d82c3 → this. ConfigApply now carries a declared percentage into kbr.type, which the value generator branches on; without it every declared percentage rendered through the count magnitude heuristics.
